edges.claim: Coinbase's public dashboard reports cbXRP supply and XRP reserves and describes 1:1 backing.
Provider-derived data reports 118.55M cbXRP collateral in the identified Base market; raw-block reproduction pending.
The market reports $59.20M outstanding USDC debt.
The 62.5% LLTV and January 15 creation date match Coinbase's XRP loan terms announced February 18. Coinbase does not publish the exact market ID and Morpho is permissionless.
Market page identifies ChainlinkOracleV2 XRP/USD with a one-day heartbeat and 0.5% deviation; full addresses/raw rounds remain unverified.
Two Steakhouse vaults supply $38.68M; together with Clearstar's $13.17M, top three contribute about 79.2% of displayed USDC supply.
Clearstar cbAssets Vault V2 is shown supplying $13.17M.

hypotheses.statement: The 62.5% cbXRP/USDC Morpho market is the market underlying Coinbase's XRP-backed USDC loan product.
disconfirming_evidence: Morpho is permissionless; another actor could deploy matching parameters.
Coinbase does not publish the exact market ID or borrower-interface mapping.
tests_needed: Compare public contract addresses and transaction traces to Coinbase product flows where available.

hypotheses.statement: Most cbXRP supply remains concentrated in the 62.5% Morpho collateral market rather than broadly distributed across independent DeFi uses.
disconfirming_evidence: Current collateral amount is provider-derived, not raw-block verified.
Other Morpho markets and non-Morpho holders are not fully inventoried.
tests_needed: Reproduce ERC-20 totalSupply and all major holder balances at the same Base block.
Enumerate every Morpho market and non-Morpho protocol holder.

hypotheses.statement: Outstanding USDC debt grew faster than cbXRP collateral units between August 24 and November 1, raising the aggregate debt-to-collateral ratio.
disconfirming_evidence: Endpoints use different provider snapshots and are not exact-block synchronized.
Aggregate ratio hides borrower-level LTV, top-ups, repayments and liquidations.
tests_needed: Reconstruct both market states at exact blocks and calculate borrower-level LTV distributions.

hypotheses.statement: Growth in cbXRP collateralized borrowing is not by itself evidence of new XRP spot purchases or net capital inflow into XRP.
disconfirming_evidence: Some users may have purchased XRP before wrapping; aggregate data cannot identify acquisition source.
tests_needed: Reconcile public XRPL reserve inflows, cbXRP mint events and exchange trade flow; do not infer purchases from wrapper issuance.

limitations: MorphoWatch is an independent data provider; raw block/query is not exposed.
Coinbase reserve refresh timezone is unstated.
Prior $240.85M value-secured field is unresolved and excluded.
DefiLlama fields are not comparable to MorphoWatch fields.
Market-wide debt/collateral ratio is not borrower LTV.
USDC lending supply/borrowing is not automatically XRP spot demand.
